create_optimizer_schedulefree: create a schedule-free AdamW optimizer with configurable learning rate, betas, and weight decay
switch_eval_mode_optimizer: switch the schedule-free AdamW optimizer to eval mode for inference or checkpoint saving
switch_train_mode_optimizer: switch the schedule-free AdamW optimizer to train mode before starting training steps
run_optimization_step: run a single optimization step with the schedule-free AdamW optimizer including gradient computation
configure_warmup_schedule: configure linear learning rate warmup and polynomial weighting parameters for the schedule-free optimizer
